messages.author: a4a92c9eded78b42
messages.subject: Re: install ffmpeg for using saveVideo in R animations package
parts: I can see that from a sysadmin perspective, it might be hard to decide which system packages should be supported on the shiny server, but I'd like to put in a vote for installing ffmpeg (or equivalent avconv) to support  Yihui Xie's  animation package (http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/animation/index.html).   I think that being able to generate and export animated statistical graphics will be a really powerful feature for Shiny.  However, I can imagine this would potentially raise issues about system resource usage and download bandwidth.  Maybe there is some way to have a cap or quota?

On Tuesday, July 29, 2014 2:46:04 PM UTC-7, Kirk Li wrote:
Hi, 

I am wondering if it is possible to have ffmpeg installed on shiny io that I can compile videos using animations pacakge in shinyapp. 

Many thanks.

Best
